summary: Independent DAY discovery pass found no defensible new admission candidate from the sources checked, but it reinforced two under-modeled 2036 dependencies: autonomous-vehicle certification/compliance throughput and grid-planning computation/software. Machine freshness is healthy, yet cadence-due intelligent discovery is not complete enough to set discoveryScanCompleted=true because several daily listing/event families were not independently exhausted and FINRA remains partition-freshness only.

materialFindings.finding: The 0000Z machine cycle is fresh and complete at the machine layer: 250/250 companies observed, identity/tradability validated, machine source coverage 1.0, while supervisor coverage remains 0 and discoveryScanCompleted=false.

Automated source health is 4/4 for FINRA, USAspending, ClinicalTrials.gov and FDA. FINRA explicitly reports observationMode=partition-freshness and eventDataAvailable=false, so freshness cannot be represented as row-level OTC event acquisition.

NHTSA's Sept. 4 Cybercab Audit Query shows that purpose-built AV deployment can face a certification/compliance bottleneck distinct from autonomy software capability; NHTSA is reviewing whether a vehicle without traditional controls can self-certify against existing FMVSS while rulemaking is still underway.

DOE's Sept. 1 GridFM 2.0 program targets orders-of-magnitude acceleration in utility planning by using foundation models to evaluate up to 1 billion grid scenarios in 24 hours. This is a weak signal that planning/simulation throughput may become its own grid bottleneck/beneficiary layer rather than only physical transformers and generation hardware.

The current discovery pool still contains only XTND as an outside challenger and keeps admissionEligible=false pending full methodology and capital-structure review; this pass found no primary-source basis to change that state.

proposedCanonicalChanges.proposal: Structural lane should test a distinct AV certification/compliance-throughput node with explicit company-level relevance and falsifiers before Chief considers causal promotion.

Evaluate whether grid-planning computation/software deserves a separate Road-to-2036 dependency/metric rather than being buried inside generic grid modernization; current DOE evidence is program-level, not yet company-specific.

contradictions.issue: A green automated coverage ratio does not equal complete intelligent discovery: FINRA lacks row-level events and the current supervisor state remains explicitly incomplete.

unknowns: Current row-level FINRA OTC additions/deletions/corporate actions remain unavailable from the machine probe.
Whether cadence-due NYSE, Nasdaq IPO, Cboe, SEC registration, NASA and other daily discovery families contain a material new candidate/event not surfaced by this pass.
Which listed companies, if any, have durable economic capture of AV certification/test throughput rather than merely bearing compliance cost.
Which public companies capture the GridFM/planning-software opportunity; DOE evidence currently establishes the dependency, not an investable beneficiary.

peerRequests.request: Test AV certification/compliance throughput as a non-duplicative causal constraint and grid-planning computation as a possible successor bottleneck; require company-level primary evidence and falsifiers before promotion.
Keep FINRA partition freshness distinct from row-level event capability and continue tracking which cadence-due discovery families are actually acquired versus only health-checked.

blockingIssues: Cadence-due active gating discovery review is not exhaustive enough in this pass to assert discoveryScanCompleted=true.

directivesReviewed.progress: 0000Z machine probes are fresh and key daily families were reviewed selectively, but cadence completion remains fail-closed because not every due active discovery family was exhaustively acquired and FINRA still lacks row-level events.
NHTSA primary evidence continues to support certification/compliance throughput as a distinct hypothesis worth structural testing, but discovery does not promote it canonically.
